description: Post-lowering AST conformance for grids/column_nonuniform_1d/rules/varcoeff_face_laplacian_lev_flux_bc: the compound D(K*D(u,lev),lev) replaced by the rule's makearray (interior interface-coefficient stencil aggregate over [2,7]; prescribed-flux faces at k=1 and k=8 reading the free names kdudz_bot and kdudz_top). Every binding loads fixture.esm (NLEV bound to 8 at the import edge), runs the section-9.6.3 rewrite fixpoint, and must emit a byte-identical expanded AST with zero apply_expression_template nodes (the two grid geometry templates the observeds zc and dz apply to the 9-interface array ze are fully inlined), zero unlowered rewrite-target ops, zero surviving metaparameter names, the free-name geometry arrays surviving as index references and the lev_nodes axis folded to size 9. The golden is generated by the Julia reference runner only (scripts/regenerate-goldens.sh) and compared bytewise by the other bindings.
